name: Brink of Broken
detailed_description:
Premise

The world has been put on the "Brink of Broken" after Miduza cast a horrible spell, turning nearly all to stone! Monsters roam freely, and the threat of further petrification still lurks deep in hostile territory. As the last 'Fragment,' you are tasked with stabilizing the state of the world... a task that all before you failed.

Combat

The weapons you pick up will be at your disposal in turn-based battles. Crush your enemies with heavy hitters that sacrifice defense, or poison them and hide behind a wall of shields! Only be wary of their durability, lest you get caught up in an improv wielding only leftover scraps!

Additional party members each have their own inventories, expanding your strategies and survivability. If anyone should reach 0 HP however, you will be defeated. Carefully manage who takes damage, and when, to emerge victorious in perilous encounters!

Exploration

As you traverse the world, you will find dungeons, power-ups, plenty of new weapons, and perhaps even a few secret rooms! A large majority of enemies can be avoided, allowing peaceful strolls should you be skilled at evasion.

Weirdos??

  • Buy weapons from a giant foot

  • Help a star find his granddaughter (another star)

  • Defeat a computer virus attempting to gain a physical form

  • Sunflower John

Difficulty

At default, it will be mildly challenging. Custom sliders exist to suit your needs, whether that leans towards hardcore or casual.
